description: Request latency bucket bounds, version 1: upper bounds in milliseconds, about 25 % apart. Bucket i (from 0) counts answers of at most bounds_ms[i] ms and more than bounds_ms[i - 1] (0 ms and up for the first); one bucket past the last counts answers above it. A batch.v1 latency entry counts its answers under the version it names, in as many buckets as its bounds plus one. A version never changes once a batch cites it; a change is a new version, in its own file.
